# Seller Tools India

> Free calculators and paid analytics for Amazon India (Amazon.in) sellers. Every
> uploaded file — settlement reports, order reports, label PDFs — is parsed in the
> seller's own browser and never reaches a server.

Marketplace: Amazon India only. Fees, GST and settlement formats are India-specific.
Pricing: free tools need no account. Starter ₹199/month (or ₹999/year), Pro ₹499/month
(or ₹2,499/year).

## Free calculators

- [Amazon Profit Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/profit): Estimate contribution and profit per unit after Amazon fees, product cost and the costs you enter below.
- [Amazon FBA Fee Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/fba-fee): Estimate FBA fees, fulfilment costs, and net settlement before scaling SKUs.
- [Amazon FBA Storage Fee Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/fba-storage): Model FBA storage exposure, months of cover, and aged inventory risk.
- [Amazon ACOS Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/acos): Calculate ACOS, TACoS, and ad efficiency benchmarks for Amazon PPC.
- [Amazon Break-Even ACOS Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/break-even-acos): Find break-even ACOS, target ACOS, and max CPC from margin and conversion.
- [Amazon Advertising ROAS Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/advertising-roi): Project clicks, orders, ad-attributed sales, ACOS and ROAS from your PPC budget, CPC and conversion assumptions.
- [Amazon Marketing Budget Planner](https://sellertoolsindia.com/marketing-budget): Turn a revenue target and a TACoS you choose into a monthly, weekly and daily ad budget.
- [Amazon Product Launch Budget Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/launch-budget): Plan PPC, coupons, creative, and launch investment for Amazon SKU launches.
- [Amazon Coupon ROI Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/coupon-roi): Estimate coupon-funded discount cost, incremental orders, and net contribution.
- [Amazon Price Band Optimizer](https://sellertoolsindia.com/price-bands): Amazon India fees can change sharply at specific selling-price bands. Many categories currently have lower or zero referral fees up to ₹1,000, while the exact threshold and rate depend on category. Compare nearby prices to see which gives the highest estimated contribution per unit.
- [Amazon Target Price Calculator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/target-price): Estimate the lowest selling price that reaches your target profit or margin using the costs and assumptions you enter.
- [Amazon Restock Planner](https://sellertoolsindia.com/restock-planner): Estimate when to reorder and how much, from your current stock, sales rate, supplier lead time and safety buffer.

## Free tools (no login, files never leave the browser)

- [Amazon Label Extractor](https://sellertoolsindia.com/label-cropper): Crop Amazon India Easy Ship A4 label PDFs to clean 4×6 thermal-printer pages — free, fully in your browser.
- [Amazon Order Printer — Picklist & Packing Slips](https://sellertoolsindia.com/order-printer): Turn your Amazon unshipped-orders report into a printable picklist and packing slips — free, fully in your browser.
- [FNSKU Barcode Sticker Generator](https://sellertoolsindia.com/fnsku-labels): Free FNSKU barcode sticker generator for Amazon FBA — Code 128 labels on A4 65/40/24-up sheets or 4×6 thermal, generated fully in your browser.
- [GST Invoice Generator — Self-Ship Invoices](https://sellertoolsindia.com/gst-invoice): Generate GST-compliant tax invoices for your Amazon.in self-ship orders from the unshipped-orders report — free, fully in your browser.
- [Amazon Link Builder](https://sellertoolsindia.com/link-builder): Generate Amazon India 2-step URLs, canonical URLs and add-to-cart links from an ASIN and keyword — free, in your browser.
- [Amazon Keyword Combiner](https://sellertoolsindia.com/keyword-combiner): Combine word lists into every long-tail keyword permutation for Amazon PPC campaigns — broad, phrase and exact match, free in your browser.
- [Amazon Listing Quality Checker](https://sellertoolsindia.com/listing-checker): Score your Amazon.in listing against title, bullet and description style rules — banned phrases, length limits and keyword coverage, live in your browser.
- [Payout Date Forecaster](https://sellertoolsindia.com/payout-forecast): Forecast your next 6 Amazon.in settlement closes, bank-credit dates and estimated deposit amounts — free, entirely in your browser.

## Paid reports (Starter ₹199/month, Pro ₹499/month)

- [Amazon Settlement Analyzer](https://sellertoolsindia.com/settlement-analyzer): Upload your Amazon settlement report and see every fee, tax and deduction itemised. Runs fully in your browser.
- [GST & TCS Report](https://sellertoolsindia.com/gst-report): Upload your Amazon settlement report and get the GST, TCS and TDS numbers you need for monthly filing — computed locally in your browser.
- [SKU Profitability Report](https://sellertoolsindia.com/sku-report): Upload your Amazon settlement report to see each SKU's settlement contribution after fees, taxes and refunds — and true profit once you add product costs. Computed locally in your browser.
- [Reconciliation & SAFE-T Finder](https://sellertoolsindia.com/reconcile): Cross-check your Amazon settlement and MTR files for missing referral-fee credits, potential SAFE-T cases, unpaid shipments and loss-making orders — locally in your browser.
- [Multi-Month Trends](https://sellertoolsindia.com/trends): Drop several Amazon settlement files and see your business month by month: sales, fees as a percentage of sales, refund rate and net payout — computed locally in your browser.
- [Fee Band Optimizer](https://sellertoolsindia.com/fee-bands): Find the SKUs sitting just above an Amazon fee step — a rupee over a referral band or a gram over a weight band — and what moving them under is worth, computed from your own settlement files in your browser.
- [Ads Optimizer](https://sellertoolsindia.com/ads-optimizer): Drop your Sponsored Products Search Term report and get the lists that matter: search terms to negate, terms that earned an exact-match campaign, terms converting at a loss, and a campaign scoreboard — computed in your browser.
- [Returns Analyzer](https://sellertoolsindia.com/returns): Drop your settlement files plus Amazon's two return reports and see what returns really cost per SKU — how much comes back sellable, what share is courier RTO rather than the product, and the return reasons grouped into actions.
- [Storage Fee Analyzer](https://sellertoolsindia.com/storage): Drop Amazon's Monthly Storage Fees report and see which ASINs pay the warehouse rent, which pay rent while selling nothing, and how many months of stock are sitting on the shelf.
- [RTO Radar](https://sellertoolsindia.com/rto): Drop Amazon's All Orders report and see where your parcels come back from: RTO rate by state, repeat-RTO pincodes, per-SKU RTO economics and the value stuck in transit back to you.
- [Stranded Inventory](https://sellertoolsindia.com/stranded): Drop Amazon's Stranded Inventory report and see the stock sitting in the warehouse that cannot sell — its value, how long it has been stuck, and the exact fix per row.
- [Traffic Doctor](https://sellertoolsindia.com/traffic): Drop the Business Report (Detail Page Sales & Traffic by Child Item) to see where to investigate each underperforming ASIN first: low traffic, weak conversion or low Featured Offer share.
- [Ad Profitability by SKU](https://sellertoolsindia.com/ad-profit): Join your Amazon settlement with the Sponsored Products advertised-product report to see ACOS, break-even ACOS and which SKUs stop making money once ads are counted.
